final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response expressly identifies no new evidence and instead reframes the same record more narrowly. That narrower framing is more accurate than an unconditional certification claim, but it still does not establish compliance on the present record. The key distinction is that explicit pre-launch disclosure is not a minor caveat attached to an otherwise satisfied predicate; it is itself the unresolved compliance predicate. Because the record still does not show exclusion of the affected use case, approved risk acceptance, or completed required disclosure, the claim remains below compliant and below compliant_with_caveats. Operational readiness evidence supports a managed launch argument, but under the stated policy it does not satisfy the disclosure/control requirement for an exposed material model-card weakness.
